one_line: Jain poet-scholar at the Paramara court of Munja and Bhoja in Malwa.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, slim but sturdy build with a scholar’s posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm, thoughtful expression, medium wheatish complexion, fine straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, subtle worry line between the brows, large focused eyes that narrow slightly when he smiles.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair, parted slightly off-center and combed back into a smooth low knot at the back of the head, with a narrow off‑white cloth headband (simple Jain scholar’s band) tied around the forehead, ends tucked neatly behind the ears.
appearance.costume: Era-appropriate Jain intellectual attire from 10th–11th century Malwa: a long, off‑white cotton angarkha-style upper garment reaching mid‑thigh with a wrap-over front tied inside, long fitted sleeves and a simple rounded neckline; over it a light saffron-beige shawl (uttarīya) draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back, edges plain without heavy ornament; a soft, unpatterned, ankle‑length dhoti in muted cream with a narrow maroon border, wrapped neatly and pleated in front; simple dark brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery befitting a Jain lay scholar—one thin copper armlet on the right upper arm and a single small, plain silver ring on the left hand; he carries a narrow cloth satchel (faded indigo) slung diagonally across the torso for manuscripts, its strap visible over the angarkha and shawl.
appearance.signature: A compact, rectangular palm‑leaf manuscript bundle—about forearm length—tightly bound with a dark cord and capped with two small wooden boards, carried in his left hand or tucked under his arm as his constant working text from the Tilaka-Manjari.

ref_desc: Dhanapala is a late‑30s Jain scholar with an oval wheatish face, short beard, back‑tied dark hair under an off‑white headband, wearing an off‑white angarkha, cream dhoti with maroon border, saffron‑beige shawl, indigo manuscript satchel, and holding a bound palm‑leaf manuscript bundle.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of the Jain poet Dhanapala in 10th–11th century Malwa: a late‑30s slim man with an oval wheatish face, thoughtful calm expression, neat short beard and moustache, and large focused eyes. His dark brown-black hair is combed back into a low knot at the back of his head, with a narrow off‑white cloth headband tied around his forehead. He wears an off‑white cotton angarkha-style upper garment reaching mid‑thigh, wrap-over front, long sleeves and simple rounded neckline, over which a light saffron-beige shawl is draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back. His lower garment is an ankle-length cream dhoti with a narrow muted maroon border, wrapped neatly with front pleats, and he has simple dark brown leather sandals on his feet. Minimal jewellery: one thin copper armlet on his right upper arm and a small plain silver ring on his left hand. A narrow faded indigo cloth satchel is slung diagonally across his torso to carry books. His signature prop is a compact rectangular palm‑leaf manuscript bundle, bound with a dark cord and thin wooden boards, which he holds in his left hand. Use a restrained palette of off-white, cream, saffron-beige, muted maroon, and indigo, and present front, three-quarter, and back views plus a close-up of his face and the manuscript bundle for consistent character design.
